newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 16.
newsitem.headline: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 16.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
GE Capital International Holdings Corporation increased its relevant interest in Loscam Limited on 20/03/1997, from 102,954,909 ordinary shares (81.74%) to 108,313,509 ordinary shares (85.99%).
Downer Group Australia Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Century Drilling Limited on 15/04/1997, from 30,395,541 ordinary shares (55.65%) to 33,859,361 ordinary shares (61.99%).
N.M. Rothschild & Sons (Australia) Pty Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Western Metals Limited on 25/03/1997, from 11,624,742 ordinary shares (8.29%) to 17,823,655 ordinary shares (5.66%).
Colonial Limited decreased its relevant interest in Colonial Commercial Property Trust on 15/04/1997, from 21,214,470 ordinary shares (22.33%) to 20,511,030 ordinary shares (19.91%).
Perpetual Trustees Australia Ltd increased its relevant interest in Carillon Development Limited on 15/04/1997, from 2,749,463 ordinary shares (11.36%) to 3,033,436 ordinary shares (12.53%).

Australia & New Zealand Banking Group Limited became a substantial shareholder in Stadium Australia Group on 11/04/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 23,521,000 ordinary shares (68.46%).
N.M. Rothschild & Sons (Australia) Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Nautronix Limited on 14/04/1997, from 3,070,000 ordinary shares (6.36%) to 3,650,553 ordinary shares (7.56%).
Colonial Limited increased its relevant interest in Aurora Gold Limited on 15/04/1997, from 10,448,759 ordinary shares (6.51%) to 12,854,488 ordinary shares (8.00%).
Churchill Resources Holdings Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Churchill Resources NL on 15/04/1997, from 62,763,066 ordinary shares (58.17%) to 62,813,066 ordinary shares (58.21%).

Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Holdings Australia Limited decreased its relevant interest in Stadium Australia Group on 15/04/1997, from 23,598,000 Gold Stapled securities (68.5%) to 20,769,000 Gold Stapled securities (60.3%) with the Platinum Stapled Securities remaining the same at 28,000 (2.3%).
Natwest Markets Australia Ltd increased its relevant interest in Structural Systems Limited on 14/05/1997, from 927,619 ordinary shares (8.10%) to 1,242,817 ordinary shares (9.26%).

Macquarie Bank Limited decreased its relevant interest in Stadium Australia Group on 15/04/1997, of fully paid ordinary Gold Stapled Securities from 23,705,000 ordinary shares (68.91%) to 2,916,000 ordinary shares (8.48%) and increased its relevant interest in fully paid ordinary Platinum Stapled Securities from 48,000 (4.00%) to 58,000 (4.83%).
Colonial Ltd increased its relevant interest in Infrastructure Trust Of Australia Group on 15/04/1997, from 25,218,000 ordinary shares (8.41%) to 31,569,200 ordinary shares (10.52%).
Colonial Limited increased its relevant interest in Flight Centre Limited on 15/04/1997, from 3,956,796 ordinary shares (5.03%) to 5,286,198 ordinary shares (6.73%).
